description: Every Catapult GPS metric — ACWR, velocity benchmarks, load reports — from one command, with a local SQLite mirror for offline analysis.

tools.name: activities_annotations
tools.description: Annotations on an activity. Required: activity_id. Returns array of Annotation.

tools.name: activities_athletes
tools.description: Athletes who participated in an activity. Required: activity_id. Returns array of Athlete.

tools.name: activities_devices
tools.description: Devices used in an activity. Required: activity_id. Returns array of Device.

tools.name: activities_get
tools.description: Get one activity; use --embed all for tag/athlete detail. Required: activity_id. Optional: embed. Returns the Activity.

params.name: embed
params.description: Set to 'all' to embed related entities

tools.name: activities_list
tools.description: List activities (sessions and matches) with venue and timing. Optional: start-time, end-time. Returns array of Activity.

tools.name: activities_periods
tools.description: Periods (halves, quarters, drills) within an activity. Required: activity_id. Returns array of Period.

tools.name: annotations_categories
tools.description: List annotation categories. Returns array of AnnotationCategory.

tools.name: athletes_annotations
tools.description: Annotations recorded against an athlete. Required: athlete_id. Returns array of Annotation.

tools.name: athletes_bands
tools.description: Velocity/acceleration band thresholds configured for an athlete. Required: athlete_id. Optional: band_name. Returns array of Band.

params.name: band_name
params.description: Filter to a single named band

tools.name: athletes_list
tools.description: List all athletes with physical attributes, jersey numbers, and positions. Returns array of Athlete.

tools.name: customer_get
tools.description: Customer account info. Returns the CustomerInfo.

tools.name: customer_settings
tools.description: User settings including velocity and distance units. Returns the Settings.

tools.name: parameters_list
tools.description: List every parameter (metric) available in OpenField, with slugs used by stats queries. Returns array of Parameter.

tools.name: periods_annotations
tools.description: Annotations on a period. Required: period_id. Returns array of Annotation.

tools.name: periods_athletes
tools.description: Athletes in a period. Required: period_id. Returns array of Athlete.

tools.name: sensor_data
tools.description: 10Hz sensor stream for one athlete in one activity (large; requires sensor-read-only scope). Required: activity_id, athlete_id. Returns array of SensorSample.

tools.name: sensor_efforts
tools.description: Generation-2 velocity or acceleration efforts for one athlete in one activity. Required: activity_id, athlete_id, effort-types. Returns array of Effort.

tools.name: sensor_events
tools.description: IMA events (jumps, dives, sport-specific movements) for one athlete in one activity. Required: activity_id, athlete_id, event-types. Returns array of ImaEvent.

tools.name: stats_query
tools.description: Query computed statistics. Body: parameter slugs, group_by dims (athlete, activity, period, position, team), and filters (date, activity_id, athlete_id, lastActivities...). Required: parameters, group_by. Optional: requested-only (default: true), source, filters. Returns array of StatRow.

params.name: source
params.description: Set to annotation_stats to query the annotation database

tools.name: teams_list
tools.description: List teams. Returns array of Team.

tools.name: venues_get
tools.description: Get one venue. Required: venue_id. Returns the Venue.

tools.name: venues_list
tools.description: List venues. Returns array of Venue.
